description: An injective list of \(k\) elements in a finite domain implies that the domain has at least \(k\) elements.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ExistentialUniversalSentences.distinct_values_bound.{u_1} {M : Type u_1} [Fintype M] {k : ℕ}
  (a : Fin k → M) (h : Function.Injective a) : k ≤ Fintype.card M
